options.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a high fidelity DESIGN PROPOSAL BOARD, landscape approximately 2400 by 1400 pixels. It contains TWO equally sized desktop web page previews side by side with a modest gap and a small caption above each: LEFT "스터디 목록", RIGHT "스터디 상세". Each preview shows the existing Korean study app "공부의 숲", warm ivory paper, watercolor forest foliage only at outer left/right and bottom edges, large ivory rounded thin sage bordered panels, charcoal readable sans-serif Korean text, olive green watercolor pill buttons. Keep the basic app layout consistent in both previews. Left page header has green brush style "공부의 숲" wordmark on left and "스터디 만들기" small green pill on right. Below: upper rounded section titled "북마크한 스터디" with three compact study cards; lower larger rounded section titled "스터디 둘러보기", search box and sort, six tidy study cards in three columns and two rows. Cards use muted sage, ivory, butter yellow and pale peach backgrounds, simple study title and tiny leaf point badge, no people photos. Right page has the same wordmark header and a large rounded ivory panel with top action text links "공유하기 | 수정하기 | 스터디 삭제하기" (only deletion red), bold title "연우의 개발공장", short introduction, green "310P 획득" badge, two pale green pill navigation buttons "오늘의 습관", "오늘의 집중". Lower panel titled "습관 기록표" contains a clean weekly habit table, seven day columns and five habit rows with pale green/gray circular paw checks. Supporting small Korean copy may be minimal and restrained. Do not redesign core structure or add sidebar, toolbar, big banner, extra functions or navigation. Reference image 1 is the watercolor background/palette; any additional reference images are character identity references only. Create polished realistic UI concept screenshots, NOT handdrawn wireframes, not literal code. Content should dominate decoration. Add one clear option title across top of whole board. OPTION TITLE exact: "A · 캐릭터 없이 깔끔하게". Both list and detail have populated data as specified. REMOVE ALL CHARACTERS completely from BOTH pages. Do not add any mascots, faces, books with faces, animals or cartoon props. Keep only the existing soft watercolor forest background and the sprout logo. Broad calm margins, no floating decoration or bottom-right sticker. This is the clean functional option. Keep all headings, navigation and table undisturbed.
